name: project-ledger
description: Project Ledger — a project operating system: a governance Contract, a status-honest scoreboard, a triggered work queue, paired session cadence (brief + close-out), runbook/testing/bugs/research artifacts, on-demand stakeholder digests, and analysis-first adoption — with an optional one-way mirror to Confluence + Jira and Slack / Google Chat notifiers via per-project adapters. Local-only by default. Built by Alfred Intel.
